about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Orange Almond Biscotti
recipes.summary: Twice-baked Italian biscuits with almonds and orange zest, made for dunking.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a tray. Mix the flour, sugar and baking powder.
Beat the eggs with the zest and vanilla, stir into the flour, then knead in the almonds to form a stiff dough.
Shape into a log 30cm long and 6cm wide and bake for 30 minutes until firm and pale golden. Cool for 15 minutes.
Slice the log on the diagonal into 20 pieces, 1.5cm thick, lay cut side down and bake for 15 minutes more, turning once, until dry and golden.
Cool on a rack for 20 minutes, where they crisp up further.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 biscotti.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Soft Ginger Biscuits
recipes.summary: Spicy golden-brown ginger biscuits with a chewy centre.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line two trays.
Beat the butter, sugar and golden syrup, then beat in the yolk.
Stir in the flour, ginger and bicarbonate of soda to make a soft dough.
Roll into 20 balls, place 5cm apart and flatten slightly.
Bake for 12 minutes until golden at the edges and cracked on top. Cool for 10 minutes on the tray.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 to 3 biscuits.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg yolk.

recipes.title: Fudgy Brownie Bites
recipes.summary: Rich, fudgy chocolate squares with a crackly top.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a 20cm square tin.
Melt the butter and chocolate together over low heat, stirring until smooth, and cool for 5 minutes.
Whisk in the sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour and cocoa.
Stir through the walnuts, pour into the tin and bake for 22 minutes until the top is crackly and a skewer has a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin for 30 minutes, then cut into 18 squares.
notes: Plus 30 minutes cooling.
Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 squares.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Mango Yoghurt Ice Blocks
recipes.summary: Creamy mango and yoghurt ice blocks with a pinch of ground ginger.
steps: Blend the mango, yoghurt, honey, ginger and lemon juice for 2 minutes until completely smooth.
Pour into 6 ice-block moulds.
Freeze for 5 hours until solid.
Run the moulds under warm water for 10 seconds to release.
Eat straight away while the ice block is firm and before it starts to drip.
notes: Plus 5 hours freezing.
Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 ice block.

recipes.title: Baked Polenta Chips
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged baked polenta fingers with rosemary and sea salt.
steps: Bring the water and salt to the boil, whisk in the polenta and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring, until very thick.
Spread into a lined 20cm tin and cool for 1 hour until firm.
Heat the oven to 220°C fan (240°C conventional). Cut into 16 chips and toss with the oil and rosemary.
Bake on a tray for 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Serve with the yoghurt as a dip.
notes: Plus 1 hour setting.
Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 4 chips with dip.

recipes.title: Cheese and Tomato Pizza Scrolls
recipes.summary: Soft yeast-free scrolls spread with tomato paste and cheese, a classic school lunchbox snack.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional) and line a tray.
Mix the flour, yoghurt and salt into a soft dough and knead for 2 minutes until smooth.
Roll into a 25 x 35cm rectangle, spread with the tomato paste, then scatter with oregano and mozzarella.
Roll up from the long side and cut into 12 slices.
Place cut side up and bake for 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool for 5 minutes.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 scrolls.

recipes.title: Potato Latkes
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged grated potato pancakes with onion, served with apple and sour cream.
steps: Squeeze the grated potato and onion hard in a tea towel to remove the liquid.
Mix with the eggs, flour and salt.
Heat the oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat and spoon in heaped tablespoons, flattening each into a disc.
Fry for 3 to 4 minutes each side until deep golden and crisp, draining on paper towel.
Serve hot with the grated apple and sour cream.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 4 latkes.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Fish Fingers with Tartare Dip
recipes.summary: Crumb-coated white fish strips baked until crisp, with a quick pickle and yoghurt dip.

items: 400g firm white fish fillets, such as barramundi

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C fan (240°C conventional). Cut the fish into 12 fingers.
Roll in the flour, then the beaten egg, then the breadcrumbs.
Place on a lined tray, drizzle with the oil and bake for 15 minutes, turning once, until golden and the fish flakes easily and reaches at least 63°C.
Mix the yoghurt, pickles and lemon juice for the dip.
Serve the fish fingers hot straight from the oven with the dip alongside.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 3 fish fingers with dip.
Food safety: keep raw fish refrigerated, cook to at least 63°C and wash hands and boards after handling raw fish and egg.

recipes.title: Cheesy Corn Muffins
recipes.summary: Savoury cornbread muffins with cheddar and chives.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional) and line a 6-hole muffin tin.
Mix the polenta, flour, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the milk, egg and oil, then stir into the dry mix with the corn, cheddar and chives until just combined.
Divide between the holes and bake for 20 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 1 muffin.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Wedges with Yoghurt Dip
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged baked sweet potato wedges with smoked paprika and a lemony yoghurt dip.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C fan (240°C conventional).
Cut the sweet potato into thick wedges and toss with the oil, paprika and salt.
Spread on two trays without crowding and roast for 35 minutes, turning once, until the edges are crisp and a knife slides in easily.
Stir the yoghurt, lemon juice and garlic together.
Serve the wedges hot with the dip.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: a quarter of the wedges with dip.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Filo Rolls
recipes.summary: Crisp filo cigars filled with spinach, ricotta and lemon.
steps: Wilt the spinach in a pan for 2 minutes, cool for 10 minutes, squeeze very dry and chop.
Mix with the ricotta, egg, lemon zest, nutmeg and salt.
Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Halve each filo sheet, brush with oil, spoon filling along one short edge and roll into a cigar, folding in the sides.
Place seam down on a lined tray, brush with the remaining oil and bake for 20 minutes until deep golden.
Rest for 5 minutes before eating.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 or 3 rolls.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Prawn Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
recipes.summary: Fresh rice paper rolls with cooked prawns, herbs and vermicelli, served with a peanut dipping sauce.
steps: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 5 minutes until tender, drain and rinse under cold water.
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds until just pliable and lay flat.
Arrange 2 prawn halves, a little vermicelli, carrot, cucumber and mint, then fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Repeat with the remaining sheets until you have 12 tightly rolled rolls.
Whisk the peanut butter, hoisin, warm water and lime juice until smooth and serve for dipping.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 3 rolls with dip.
Food safety: use cooked prawns kept below 5°C, eat the rolls within 4 hours of making, and discard any left out for more than 2 hours.

recipes.title: Oat and Raisin Cookies
recipes.summary: Chewy oat cookies packed with raisins and cinnamon.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the egg.
Fold in the flour, oats, raisins, bicarbonate of soda and cinnamon.
Roll into 16 balls, place 5cm apart and flatten slightly.
Bake for 12 minutes until golden at the edges but soft in the middle. Cool for 10 minutes on the tray.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 cookies.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Bruschetta Bites
recipes.summary: Crisp baguette slices topped with juicy tomatoes, basil and garlic.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional).
Brush the baguette slices with 2 tbsp oil and bake for 8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Mix the tomato, garlic, basil, vinegar, salt and remaining oil, and rest for 10 minutes.
Spoon onto the toasts just before serving.
Eat within 15 minutes so the bread stays crisp.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: 4 bites.

recipes.title: Honey Soy Chicken Drumettes
recipes.summary: Sticky baked chicken wing drumettes in a honey, soy and ginger glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional).
Mix the soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic and toss with the chicken.
Spread on a lined tray and bake for 35 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky, deep golden and at least 75°C at the thickest part.
Scatter with the sesame seeds.
Rest for 5 minutes before eating.
notes: Snack. Per serving: about 5 drumettes.
Food safety: cook chicken to at least 75°C, wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken, and refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
